senses.gloss:
Chachakkasutta
Bud. Pāli. Majjhimanikāya, Upari Paṇṇāsaka. 48. on the six “sixes” viz. six internal senses, six external sense-objects, six perceptions an. six cravings.
Pt.. (1) with Buddhaghoṣa's C. an. Sinhalese word for word transl., Brendiyavatta, 1896. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 707. (2) Majjhima Nikāya III. p.. 380-88. Nalandā Dng. Pāli. Ser. 1958. [Page092-b]

Chāchiga
father of Hemacandra, the Jain writer. See Jainism in Rajasthan p. 207.
